study: Prospective UDP socket lifecycle and established DoH controls
priming: Each name queried through all three treatments before each window; resolver cache-hit status remains unknown
fresh_udp: New unconnected udp4 socket, explicit await bind(0) inside whole-call timing, then send and validation. Historical collector used implicit bind, so this is an explicit implementation change.
bound_udp: One unconnected udp4 socket per provider/window; bind occurs outside measured calls and the source port is retained.
doh: One established HTTP/2 TLS connection per provider/window, primed before measured calls; no reconnect or TLS resumption permitted in a valid measured warm call.
timing: Query construction excluded. elapsed_ms includes socket lifecycle where applicable, submission, response and validation. UDP transport_elapsed_ms is send() call to message callback after both modes have bound. H2 phase fields are event-loop/client timestamps, not packet-capture transmission times.
interpretation: Fresh-versus-bound contrasts can also reflect source-port dependent routing, ECMP, NAT or resolver affinity. Neither phase decomposition nor matched provider establishes pure CPU or encryption cost.
failure_policy: No retries or imputation. All attempts including setup/timeout failures are stored. Failed timings are excluded from successful latency estimates.
